comment: Manual corrections applied by scripts/build-transit-network.mjs after the automatic matching. Renames run first, so a rename can also enable a merge.
//mergeInto: stop id -> stop id it should be drawn as; lines are combined onto the target.
//addStops: route id -> stop ids the export omits. Each is slotted in at the position its geometry implies.
//moveLines: reassigns line badges the automatic name+distance matching attached to the wrong pole of a same-named pair.
